releaseName: Lokify v1.5.1 – Direct Native Package Installer & Dynamic Settings Version
changelog: Native Package Installer Fix: Streamlined APK storage in external files directory with ClipData URI permission routing, ensuring Android PackageInstaller opens reliably across all Android OS versions.
Dynamic Settings Version: Fixed Settings screen display to query actual installed version dynamically rather than showing cached strings.
Official Google Account Chooser: Seamless 1-tap sign-in with Google official account selector dialog on Web and native Android AccountManager chooser.
Clean Authentication: Removed double email prompt, cancellation dismisses smoothly without error banners, and duplicate request protection.
